articleTitle: Method for Medium- and Long-Term Reservoir Streamflow Prediction by Coupling Group Search Optimizer with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Deep learning models have great performance in streamflow prediction. This study proposes a method for medium- and long-term reservoir streamflow prediction by coupling group search optimizer with deep learning. The grey correlation entropy is used to screen the factors that have a greater impact on the predicted flow month by month, and the group search algorithm is used to iteratively search the data for the optimum to ensure that the range of the optimal time series is smaller than the limit value. Neural networks are used to calculate the weights and thresholds corresponding to the optimal time series, and the algorithm is avoided to fall into local optimality through continuous iteration to improve the prediction accuracy. Taking two large reservoirs in a basin in Southwest China as an example, the results show that the MAPE indicator is below 5% in the dry season, 7-10% in the flood season, and the NSE coefficient maintains above 0.8 and reaches 0.9 in some cases. Therefore, the method has a good prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Power Load Forecasting Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: This study aims to explore the application of artificial intelligence in power grid load forecasting. In power grid load forecasting, artificial intelligence and big data technology are used to analyze the mechanism of a variety of data information affecting the load, and new theories and methods of load forecasting are established. Neural network algorithm is mainly used to significantly improve the accuracy of load forecasting, making the process of load forecasting more intelligent and scientific, better providing basic data for the smart grid, supporting the refinement of dispatching with the accuracy of forecasting, and comprehensively improving the safe operation level of the power grid, carrying new energy generation and the ability to optimize the allocation of resources. The final research results are applied to the Shandong electric power big data analysis system. Practice shows that the application of data mining and analysis technology in power data can fully tap the value of enterprise data and better serve the power industry and the majority of power users.

articleTitle: Multi-Branch Integrated Model for Respiratory Disease Screening Using Cough Sounds
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Respiratory diseases are highly prevalent and have high mortality rates. Rapid and convenient screening provides the basis for decision making in determining whether a patient needs to seek medical attention and is key to subsequent treatment and medication. The existing diagnostic methods are limited by the healthcare environment and cannot be widely disseminated, making it difficult to meet the needs of early detection and daily dynamic monitoring of patients. Thus a multibranch integrated model based on cough sounds is proposed to screen for respiratory diseases and help the healthcare system through artificial intelligence techniques. Based on the features of the cough sound time series, extracted and fused multiple time and frequency domain features to correlate them. First, the extracted time and frequency domain features are input into the multi-branch model, and each branch runs independently and produces results. Then, each branch model screening result is voted by the principle of minority to majority, and the voting result is taken as the final output result. The multi-branch model can effectively solve the data imbalance problem by learning features on multiple timescales. The method screened 328 subjects with an accuracy of 94.04%, precision of 94.14%, recall of 91.67%, and F1 score of 92.56%. The feasibility of the RDs screening technique based on the multi-branch model of cough sounds was demonstrated through experiments. Owing to its convenience and low equipment requirements, it is expected to be an effective tool for preliminary examination of respiratory diseases and disease surveillance.

articleTitle: Research on Visualization and Virtual Reality Technology of Road and Bridge Engineering Based on BIM+GIS Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: BIM and GIS technologies are widely utilized in the construction industry. These two technologies, when combined, offer numerous advantages, particularly in road and bridge engineering. By incorporating BIM + GIS technology, road and bridge projects within smart cities can fully leverage the benefits of these technologies, enhancing implementation and scientific precision. This research focuses on road and bridge engineering visualization and virtual reality technology, utilizing BIM + GIS technology as its foundation. Through thorough literature studies and case analyses, this research holds both theoretical value and practical significance. The findings highlight that road and bridge engineering, when based on BIM + GIS technology, can not only achieve a 1:1 virtual world representation through virtual reality, but also improve the efficiency of engineering design for designers. Additionally, with the aid of visualization technology, construction and growth videos of road and bridge engineering can be generated, allowing designers and construction personnel to anticipate and understand the construction content and progress of road and bridge projects in advance.

articleTitle: Optimization of Urban Landscape Design Based on Interactive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: To meet the dynamic needs of smart city landscape design, the interactive genetic algorithm (IGA) was introduced to enhance the efficiency and adaptability of the design process. Key design parameters were defined as genes, and a fitness function was constructed. The study combined genetic algorithm operations (selection, crossover, mutation) with user interface feedback for algorithm adjustment and multi-objective optimization. The results showed a significant enhancement in urban landscape design capabilities, with designer ratings reaching as high as 9.1 out of 10, and local search optimization requiring only 0.08 hours. This method improved urban landscape design, emphasizing the importance of applying adaptive and user-centric approaches in urban planning. By integrating user preferences and environmental considerations, it ensured a sustainable and aesthetically pleasing urban environment, contributing to the development of smart cities.

articleTitle: Spraying Path Planning Method for Indoor Painting Robots with Uniform Paint Film Thickness
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The Robot-City Interaction is one of the characteristics of smart cities. Painting robots have become an research focus for the development and application of intelligent construction. The indoor painting robot needs to ensure uniform paint film thickness during the spraying process in complex indoor environments. The relationship between the robot spraying path and thickness distribution was analyzed. The trajectory of the robot spraying path is planned in joint space and operating space. The plan method controls that the thickness distribution of the paint film after a single spray is between 15–20 μm. Based on MoveIt, robot motion planning was implemented, self collision detection and obstacle avoidance planning in the spraying environment were completed, and physical simulation environment validation was conducted. A hardware and software platform for the robot was designed and built. The autonomous spraying and the spraying path planning of the painting robot has been verified in the experiments.

articleTitle: Tobacco Maturity Recognition Based on an Improved YOLOv8 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Tobacco maturity is an important factor in determining tobacco baking, and the existing means of tobacco maturity detection are usually based on manual detection, lacking objective and uniform detection standards. In this paper, a new object detection algorithm GSSS-YOLO is proposed based on the YOLOv8 algorithm. The GSSS-YOLO introduces the CPCA attention mechanism to raise the precision of the detection, and the loss function SIoU is used to speed up the model's convergence speed. Finally, the tobacco maturity recognition model is trained using nearly 3700 tobacco leaves collected in a real environment, and the results of experiment indicate that the proposed detection algorithm has good detection accuracy and detection efficiency. The proposed GSSS-YOLO algorithm can be deployed on an embedded platform to realize on-line tobacco maturity recognition, which is very important for improving the efficiency of tobacco harvesting.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Monitoring System of Electrical Tower Shape Change Based on GNSS
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: In order to avoid the safety accidents caused by the deformation of the electric tower, it is necessary to monitor and warn the electric tower in real time. Based on the global satellite navigation system (GNSS), an intelligent automatic monitoring system for electric tower deformation is designed in this paper, which aims to automatically collect the data of electric tower deformation and send out early warning information for dangerous deformation. The system adopts RTK positioning principle, eliminates noise error through Kalman filtering algorithm, and introduces least square estimation model to optimize GNSS observation equation, and obtains accurate monitoring data of electric tower deformation. The two-level data fusion analysis method is used to design the early warning system, and the early warning information is pushed to the user by mail or short message. Through the introduction of the principle and software design of the monitoring system for electric tower deformation, a field test was carried out in an electric tower in Ji 'an, Jiangxi Province. It was found that the horizontal deformation accuracy of the system could reach -5 ~ 5mm, and the vertical deformation accuracy could reach -8 ~ 8 mm. The system can meet the requirements of tower monitoring and provide a reference for the research and development of related systems.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Mask Wearing Behavior Detection Model Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: This paper proposes a real-time mask wearing behavior detection model based on deep learning. Requesting everyone to wear masks correctly in public places is an effective way to hinder the spread of respiratory infectious diseases, which is conducive to safeguarding people's physical health and life safety. Real-time monitoring of mask wearing in public places through machines can greatly save labor costs and improve regulatory efficiency. To improve the accuracy of real-time detection of mask wearing behavior among public places, the research content of this paper includes the following aspects: training the YOLOv5 model based on deep learning technology to accurately detect faces and masks; Verify the effectiveness of facial mask detection function; Analyze data using visualization tools and check the detection performance of object detection algorithms; Design login modules and alarm function modules to further improve the functionality of the system. Through the real-time mask wearing monitoring function based on YOLOv5 and other functional modules, the system can ultimately accurately detect the wearing of faces and masks, and provide login and alarm functions to meet practical needs and improve monitoring effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Safety Risk Prediction Model of High-Speed Railway Based on Chaotic RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: At present, artificial intelligence has been rapidly developed and applied in the field of intelligent transportation. Safety risk assessment and prediction of high-speed railway operation has become an important part of intelligent high-speed railway operation management. In this paper, based on chaos theory and artificial neural network, a comprehensive risk prediction model based on the phase space delay reconstruction of chaos theory and the powerful approximation and mapping ability of RBF neural network is established. Accordingly, the high-speed railway operation risk prediction problem is transformed into a chaotic time series prediction problem, and then the RBF neural network is used to predict risk results in the future. 300 days of safety accident case data, from the public data set, are utilized to train the model and some desirable prediction results are obtained. These research results provide important theoretical and technical basis for the safe operation of high-speed railway, and have important guiding significance and reference value for the operation safety of high-speed railway in China.

articleTitle: Prediction and Analysis of Air Quality Warning Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Air quality index (AQI) is an important index to measure regional air quality, it can reflect the degree of local air pollution and the environment, and help the local to formulate effective environmental protection policies. This paper selects the basic air quality forecast data of a certain place, including PM10, PM2.5 and other ten indexes, and then uses BP neural network, Long and short term neural networks (LSTM), Random forest (RF) and Convolutional Neural Network-Long Short-Term Memory (CNN-LSTM) algorithms to build a multi-step AQI prediction model with multi-index input and single index output. Using R square, RMSE and MAE to evaluate the results of AQI prediction model, the results show that CNN-LSTM and RF model have the highest prediction accuracy. And the prediction effect is significantly better than other models, indicating that these two models are better than traditional models in dealing with such nonlinear and multi-index data. Then the trained model is used to predict the AQI index of the region in the future, and finally provide a more scientific method for the prevention and control of air pollution.

articleTitle: Research on Building Energy Consumption Decision Prediction Method Based on GMM
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Building energy prediction plays an important role in building energy management, energy conservation and fault diagnosis. Aiming at the difficulty that the features of building energy consumption data sets are nonlinearly related and there are outliers, the FGLnet building energy consumption integrated prediction model for building energy consumption based on feature extraction, clustering, and Light Gradient Boosting Machine is proposed. Firstly, the mutual information method and recursive feature elimination are used to make secondary feature selections on the original building dataset to remove redundant features. Then the data with similar features are reasonably clustered based on Gaussian Mixture Model algorithm. The several Light Gradient Boosting Machine with different parameters are used to train and predict the energy consumption data of each cluster separately. Through comparison experiments, it can be seen that the integrated model can effectively improve prediction accuracy and convergence speed.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Analysis of Land Subsidence Along the Subway Line with Time-Sequence SBAS-InSAR
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The development of regional land subsidence affects the construction and operation safety of urban rail transit. In this paper, the first phase of Xi'an Metro Line 9 is taken as the research area, and the SBAS-InSAR technology is used to process 22 Sentinel-1A images covering the study area during 2021.01 to 2022.07, to obtain the land subsidence information of the subway line, and further analyze the temporal and spatial distribution characteristics of the subway line and typical sections during the operation. The results show that: (1) the area of Dianzizhengjie has obvious uplift, and the subsidence near the industrial zone of Huaxu Town in Lantian County is more serious, with the maximum accumulated subsidence reaching 147.70mm; (2) The maximum land subsidence along the subway line is 44.05mm, which appears near Hongqing Station; (3) The cumulative subsidence difference between Huaqingchi Station and Qinlingxi Station reached the maximum of 10.59mm, and the land subsidence near Qinlingxi Station showed a trend of gradual expansion. In this paper, an example of InSAR technology in ground deformation monitoring along the subway line is studied, which shows that it has a broad application prospect in the research of ground deformation disaster monitoring.

articleTitle: Mongolian Education Resource Platform Based on SpringMVC+Hibernate+Spring Integration Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: The education network in the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is rapidly developing, and it is imperative to design and implement a Mongolian language education resource platform to better enhance the learning experience for Mongolian-speaking students. Against the backdrop of smart cities, this platform not only brings convenience to the education sector but also aligns with the digitization and intelligence trends in urban development. The designed Mongolian language education resource platform in this paper adopts a B/S architecture and is developed using the SpringMVC, Hibernate, and Spring frameworks. Firstly, the relevant technical knowledge used in the development, including the B/S architecture, main frameworks, and CSS technology, is introduced. Subsequently, the paper elucidates the platform's requirements and detailed design plans, including the database design. Finally, the implementation process of the core functions of the Mongolian language education resource platform is described, and unit testing is employed to test these core modules. The system has successfully realized the basic functions of the Mongolian language education resource platform, and the overall platform's functionality has met the expected goals. The implementation of this system not only enables the realization of the basic functions of the Mongolian language education resource platform but also seamlessly integrates with smart city development, providing digital and intelligent support for urban education management.

articleTitle: Enhancing Smart Park Infrastructure through the Implementation of a Comprehensive Travel Chain System Based on Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: This electronic document is a “live” template and already defines the components of your paper [title, text, heads, etc.] in its style sheet. The establishment of smart parks necessitates a focus not only on standardized management protocols within the park but also on addressing transportation and travel challenges both within and beyond its boundaries. The advent of the 5G era has given rise to autonomous driving technology as a prominent application scenario, capturing widespread attention due to the challenges associated with its commercial deployment. Notably, the autonomous driving service within the park distinguishes itself with a relatively singular traffic entity and a discernible business model, making it one of the most plausible and substantial scenarios for the commercialization of 5G and vehicular networking. To propel the development of autonomous driving services within the park, a thorough analysis of business requirements and consumer demands was undertaken. The results reveal that the application of autonomous driving within the park holds immense potential and promising market prospects. Consequently, a comprehensive smart park autonomous driving solution has been devised, leveraging 5G+C-V2X technology. The practical implementation of this solution in Fengxian District, Shanghai, serves as a foundational contribution to the intelligent transportation infrastructure in smart parks and smart cities.

articleTitle: Adaptive GA-BP Model Prediction of Subway Shield Tunneling Settlement in Smart City Construction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: In the process of building a smart city, it is sometimes necessary to excavate and construct subway tunnels underground. To avoid adverse effects of surface settlement caused by shield tunneling on the surrounding environment. It is necessary to calculate and predict surface subsidence values based on existing parameters. A series of problems exist in the GA-BP model, which is a commonly used BP neural network model. The BP neural network optimized by adaptive genetic algorithm is used to predict surface settlement during underground shield tunneling construction. An adaptive GA-BP neural network mathematical model with global optimization ability is constructed. The adaptive genetic algorithm adopts binary encoding and improves the crossover and mutation steps in the genetic algorithm. After verification, adaptive genetic algorithm can effectively improve a series of problems that exist in the convergence process of traditional genetic algorithms. Meanwhile, the BP neural network combined with adaptive genetic algorithm can overcome the disadvantage of traditional BP neural networks being prone to local optima. After practical engineering data prediction, the adaptive GA-BP neural network model has shown better performance in predicting the maximum surface subsidence compared to the traditional GA-BP neural network. However, there are still shortcomings in predicting the average subsidence, and further research and improvement are needed in algorithms, data selection, and other aspects.

articleTitle: Safety Research of Domestic Database in the Field of Traffic Construction
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: This paper summarizes the application and security situation of the current mainstream database system in China through analyzing the database security problems faced by China's current traffic building field. Taking OpenGuss domestic database in the traffic building field as the application background, this paper analyzes its security architecture and existing security problems, and proposes a security detection AI model that conforms to OpenGuss AI architecture, This model can effectively solve the random and uncertain RPC security access problem in the distributed information system of large traffic buildings, improve the monitoring performance of API access exceptions at the data level, and has very important significance and value in promoting the application of domestic database systems in the field of traffic buildings and solving the current security problems they face.

articleTitle: Comparison and Real-Life Test of Three Technical Schemes of Holographic Perception of Tunnel Traffic Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: In view of the problems that the holographic sensing technology scheme of tunnel traffic operation has not yet formed theoretical support, the technical path is not clear, and the landing deployment scheme is not mature, the research and comparative test are carried out around three mainstream holographic sensing schemes: Iidar, millimeter wave radar and high-definition video. Three different holographic sensing schemes are compared and analyzed from several dimensions, such as technical route, deployment scheme, collection results of holographic sensing elements, and detection and analysis of tunnel safety incidents. The research results show that the holographic perception requirements of tunnel traffic operation can be met under the reasonable technical deployment conditions of the three schemes. Lidar has great advantages in detection accuracy, millimeter wave radar has great advantages in anti-jamming, and high-definition video has great advantages in color acquisition.

articleTitle: Exploring Tooth Segmentation Techniques Based on the BiSeNet Model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: As people's standard of living continues to rise, oral health issues have emerged as a major concern. High-precision dental segmentation methods are crucial for the advancement of various fields, including oral medicine. Current research in oral imaging predominantly revolves around CNN deep learning models, utilizing CT or X-ray technologies for image segmentation. While the BiSeNet model, known for its real-time processing and high precision, has been widely applied in medical image analysis, its use in oral medicine is limited, and research in this area is sparse. This paper focuses on analyzing and improving the BiSeNet network by employing a dual-branch network structure that effectively integrates low-level spatial characteristics with high-level contextual features. The network's training is supervised by a primary loss function and augmented by two auxiliary loss functions. The model's performance was evaluated on various metrics, including training time, precision, recall rate, Fl Score, and the Intersection over Union (IoU). Our dataset comprised 7068 intraoral scan images. The experimental results demonstrated that BiSeNet outperforms the YOLOv8 model in balancing precision and recall, among other performance metrics, showcasing rapid training convergence and high accuracy. However, the model has its limitations, particularly in adapting to different imaging equipment and segmenting three-dimensional dental models. Future research will focus on three-dimensional dental model segmentation and semi-supervised learning methods to further optimize algorithm performance.

articleTitle: Efficient Commercial Bank Customer Credit Risk Assessment Based on LightGBM and Feature Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: Effective control of credit risk is a key link in the steady operation of commercial banks. This paper is mainly based on the customer information dataset of a foreign commercial bank in Kaggle, and we use LightGBM algorithm to build a classifier to classify customers, to help the bank judge the possibility of customer credit default. This paper mainly deals with characteristic engineering, such as missing value processing, coding, imbalanced samples, etc., which greatly improves the machine learning effect. The main innovation of this paper is to construct new feature attributes on the basis of the original dataset so that the accuracy of the classifier reaches 0.734, and the AUC reaches 0.772, which is more than many classifiers based on the same dataset. The model can provide some reference for commercial banks' credit granting, and also provide some feature processing ideas for other similar studies.

articleTitle: Prediction Method of Tea Disease Based on HP Filter and Ant Colony Grey Model
publicationTitle: 2023 5th International Symposium on Smart and Healthy Cities (ISHC)
abstract: A new prediction method is proposed for the current tea disease with high randomness and volatility, which leads to poor disease prediction accuracy. The method transforms the collected tea leaf disease spot data into a time series, considers the changes in the percentage of disease spots under different growth cycles, and establishes a gray prediction model for tea leaf disease parameters based on gray system theory based on the time characteristic series; at the same time, in order to reduce the influence of data noise, HP filtering is used for the noise reduction of the data, the fitness function is established, and an improved ant colony algorithm is used to optimally select parameters such as development coefficient and gray action volume in the gray system model. The parameters such as development coefficients and gray role volume are selected by searching for optimization. The experimental results show that the HP-ACA-GM (1,1)-based prediction curve is smoother and has better volatility compared to the GM(1,1) model and does not show a wide range of volatility deviation. The average relative error Q and variance ratio C both belong to the excellent grade, and finally the errors between the predicted values and the real values based on the HP-ACA-GM (1,1) model are all within 10%, which indicates that our model can improve the disease prediction accuracy and provide technical support for disease prevention and control in smart tea gardens.
